entities.name: Ante Šušnjar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ante Šušnjar is a Croatian politician of the Homeland Movement serving as minister of economy since 2024. He graduated from the University of Split in 2006 and worked as a lawyer and bankruptcy trustee. He is a member of the presidency of the Homeland Movement.
